name: Pci Technology Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: PCI Technology Group Co., Ltd. is a Chinese company dedicated to the development and provision of artificial intelligence technologies and products. Its core offerings comprise a comprehensive suite of cloud-based platforms for video and image processing, facial recognition, and vehicle management. The company further provides various specialized platforms, including those for video network monitoring, operations, and maintenance; a unique "one camera, one file" system; integrated grid-based social governance solutions; video structure analysis; smart police applications; video structure information databases; and combined video, data, and map applications. These advanced systems are instrumental in supporting urban public safety and optimizing urban traffic management. Beyond its platforms, PCI Technology Group delivers complete intelligent solutions for public security and rail transportation, as well as broader smart transportation systems. It also offers a range of value-added services, encompassing networking and cloud computing solutions, IT infrastructure outsourcing, and operational support. Furthermore, the company provides comprehensive IT product services, covering sales, system integration, training, consulting, and after-sales support to a diverse clientele in sectors such as government, finance, telecommunications, manufacturing, education, and information technology. Its portfolio also includes commercial smart products, sophisticated multi-payment solutions, and Internet-enhanced information services. Originally established in 1986 as PCI-Suntek Technology Co.,Ltd., the company maintains its headquarters in Guangzhou, China.
